g1-board: A continuous dark green printed circuit motherboard seen from directly above, filling the frame edge to edge: empty chip sockets with rows of small gold pads, fine gold traces running mostly vertically down the board in parallel bundles, vias, tiny surface-mount resistors and capacitors along the edges, the solder mask a deep bottle green almost black, lit only by a faint warm gold light grazing from the top and a thin red rim glow on the left edge and green rim glow on the right edge.
g2-wafer: Macro view of a dark polished silicon wafer seen from directly above, filling the frame: a regular grid of square dies separated by thin scribe streets, each die a dark mirror of near-black glass with faint fine circuit patterning, a subtle thin-film iridescence in deep green and dark red where light catches, faint gold scribe lines, the whole surface dim, like a black mirror with a faint warm sheen.
g3-rack: The inside of a dark server rack seen straight on: two vertical black steel rack rails down the left and right edges with rows of square mounting holes, the middle a deep black void with a faint grid of blanking plates and vent slots barely visible, small green and red status LEDs dotted sparsely along both rails, bundles of black cables with gold connectors running vertically down the sides, warm faint gold light from above.
g4-bus: A dark circuit board substrate seen from directly above where a wide bus of many parallel gold traces runs vertically down the middle of the frame like a highway, branching left and right into smaller traces at a few junctions, the board itself very dark green almost black with faint copper inner-layer patterns, the gold traces slightly worn and dim with a few brighter glints, red and green faint rim light at the far left and right edges.
g5-void: A black void of drifting dark smoke and fine dust motes, the ambient darkness around a painted comic object: soft volumetric haze in thin layers, a few faint warm gold glints scattered evenly, a thin deep red rim haze along the whole left edge and a deep green rim haze along the whole right edge, tiny scattered sparks, ink-hatched shadow texture, almost completely black in the middle, evenly lit from top to bottom with no glow at the top.
